chunks: Henna removes foul odor, increases the waterliness and radiance of the face, improves the breath, and beautifies one's offspring.

key_terms.السَّهَكِ: foul odor or unpleasant smell removed by henna
key_terms.النَّكْهَةَ: breath or mouth odor, here meaning pleasantness of breath
key_terms.الْحِنَّاءُ: henna; a natural dye and cosmetic mentioned here for its beneficial effects
key_terms.الْوَلَدَ: offspring or children, here indicating beautification of progeny
key_terms.ماءِ الْوَجْهِ: the freshness, brightness, or radiance of the face

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about the benefits of henna?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام describes several beneficial effects of henna related to cleanliness, appearance, and family life. It presents henna as a means of beautification and refinement, reflecting Islamic teachings that encourage taharah and good personal care.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.273 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"Henna removes the odors, increases radiance in the face, improves breath, and beautifies one's offspring."
